name: Tobira
source:
Makoto returns from study in USA to his school in Japan. He needs to choose one class door... and the person he meets there will be protagonist for the next day and will need to choose next door... Where will this constant protagonist swaps lead to?

[From [url=https://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/2637-vn-of-the-april-2001-mizuiro/]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Makoto从美国留学回到日本的学校。他需要选择一个班级门……而在那里遇到的人将是第二天的主角，需要选择隔壁……这种不断的主角互换会导致什么？

[来自[url=https://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/2637-vn-of-the-april-2001-mizuiro/]vndbreview[/url]]
